help_faq1_title: 1. How do I register an account on LAJU?
help_faq1_desc: Registration in LAJU requires zero personal identifiable information (No PII). No phone numbers, SMS codes, or email addresses needed. Just download the app, choose a unique Username, store your backup PIN, and your cryptographic keypair is generated directly on your device.
help_faq1_tip: Keep your Username and 6-digit backup PIN safe. These credentials are the only way to restore your encrypted backup on a new device.
help_faq2_title: 2. What happens if I forget my backup PIN?
help_faq2_desc: Because LAJU uses a Zero-Knowledge architecture, our servers never store your PIN. If you still have access to your device, you can update your PIN in Settings > Security. If the app is uninstalled and the PIN is lost, previous message history cannot be decrypted.
help_faq3_title: 3. Why are my messages sometimes delayed or pending?
help_faq3_desc: End-to-end encrypted messages deliver via relay nodes. If a message is delayed, ensure the recipient is connected to the internet and review Android battery optimization settings to allow background delivery.
help_faq4_title: 4. How do P2P voice and video calls work?
help_faq4_desc: Calls in LAJU use direct WebRTC Peer-to-Peer encrypted connections. Media streams directly between callers without intermediary media servers, providing crystal-clear quality and data savings.
help_faq5_title: 5. How to submit a problem ticket?
help_faq5_desc: To report bugs or issues, open Settings > Help in the LAJU app and select Submit Ticket. You can also email support@laju.chat with your app version and issue description.

privacy_meta_desc: Official privacy policy of LAJU Messenger. Your privacy and end-to-end data encryption are our absolute priority.
privacy_hero_desc: We built LAJU from the ground up on zero-knowledge foundations: what you discuss, who you contact, and what you share belongs exclusively to you. We hold no keys to inspect your conversations.
privacy_pillars_title: 4 Pillars of Data Protection in LAJU
privacy_pillars_sub: How we guarantee your conversations remain exclusively yours.
privacy_pillar1_desc: Every text, photo, video, and file is encrypted on the sender's device and can only be decrypted by the recipient's device.
privacy_pillar2_desc: Your private keys are safely stored locally on your device. Our servers never hold keys to decipher your message contents.
privacy_pillar3_desc: 100% free of third-party advertising tracking SDKs (such as AdMob or Meta). We never sell your personal profile to anyone.
privacy_pillar4_desc: Delivered messages are scrubbed from relay servers immediately. Disappearing messages ensure history is wiped on both ends automatically.
privacy_articles_sub: Last updated: September 2026 • Legally binding for all LAJU users
privacy_sec1_title: 1. 100% Anonymous Registration (No Phone Number or Email)
privacy_sec1_lead: LAJU is engineered on radical privacy principles: we never ask for, collect, or store any personal identifiable information (Zero PII).
privacy_sec1_p1_desc: No SMS, no cellular OTP codes. Your phone number is never requested or logged.
privacy_sec1_p2_desc: You never have to register, link, or verify an email address.
privacy_sec1_p3_desc: We never ask for real names, ID/passports, biometric data, or birthdays.
privacy_sec1_p4_desc: Accounts operate purely through public-private keypairs (Ed25519 & X25519) on your device.
privacy_sec2_item1_desc: Text, files, voice recordings, and media never exist in plaintext on our servers. Everything is end-to-end encrypted before transmission.
privacy_sec2_item2_desc: We never upload, sync, or copy your phonebook. Adding contacts is done voluntarily via Username or QR code.
privacy_sec2_item3_desc: We do not request background GPS tracking permissions and never record your geographic coordinates.
privacy_sec2_item4_desc: Voice and video calls stream directly peer-to-peer using encrypted WebRTC. Servers only facilitate initial signaling handshakes.
privacy_sec3_desc: If a recipient is temporarily offline when a message is sent, the encrypted payload is stored in a temporary relay queue. Once delivered, it is immediately and permanently wiped from relay memory.
privacy_sec4_desc: Privacy sovereignty is yours. Whenever you decide to stop using LAJU, use the Delete Account option in Settings. This permanently purges your public profile, sessions, keys, and group memberships with no recovery option.
